Our Story

A Local Staple, A Fresh Brand

Clover X has been cutting hair in the Clayton Heights and Cloverdale neighbourhood for over a decade. Long-time locals will remember the shop by its former name, Mister Cutts.

In 2020, the shop rebranded as Clover X Barbershop — a fresh name and a fresh look, with the same neighbourhood spirit and the same commitment to a great cut.

Whether you're a regular or it's your first visit, you'll get a warm welcome and leave looking sharp.
